name: impact-plus-plus
description: Impact++: five capstone modules in one React + FastAPI + Supabase app. See docs/README.md.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run api:setup
scripts.api:setup: cd backend && python3.13 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest -q && .venv/bin/lint-imports
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check .
scripts.e2e:serve: npm run build && cd backend && ENV=test LLM_FAKE=1 .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --workers 1
